export.connection-string-env-not-set: Recipe section `{Section}` refers to environment variable(s) {Variables}, which are not set. Connection secrets are read from the environment so they need not be committed.
export.mongodb-needs-database: Recipe section `{Section}` connection string must name a database, as in `mongodb://host:27017/mygame`.
export.mongodb-element-type-unmapped: MongoDB exporter cannot map element type `{Type}`.
export.mysql-type-unmapped: MySQL exporter cannot map type `{Type}` of column `{Column}`.
export.postgresql-type-unmapped: PostgreSQL exporter cannot map type `{Type}` of column `{Column}`.
export.redis-swap-refused: Redis refused the swap transaction for `{Key}`.
export.schema-baseline-unreadable: The schema baseline `{Baseline}` could not be read: {Detail}. Fix the file or delete it - deleting it gives up the check for one run and writes a new baseline from this schema.
export.cipher-unknown: Cipher {Cipher} is not one this build knows.
export.decrypt-failed: The file did not decrypt to a table. The key is not the one it was written with.
export.same-key-for-mac: A binary export uses the same key for encryption and for the MAC. Make a second key with `--new-encryption-key`, so that one secret is not doing the work of two.
export.key-named-twice: A binary export names both `{VariableSetting}` and `{FileSetting}`. Name one, so there is no question which {Purpose} key the files were written with.
export.key-env-not-set: The binary export asks for the {Purpose} key in environment variable `{Variable}`, which is not set.
export.key-file-missing: The binary export asks for the {Purpose} key in `{Path}`, which does not exist.
export.key-wrong-length: The {Purpose} key in {Origin} is {Length} characters. It has to be {Expected} hexadecimal characters, for {Bytes} bytes.
export.key-not-hexadecimal: The {Purpose} key in {Origin} is not hexadecimal.
export.text-format-and-template: The `text` target was given both a `Format` and a `Template`. They are two answers to what a file looks like; name one.
export.text-needs-format:
The `text` target needs a `Format` - one gathered string as a line of the file. For example:
    "Format": "NSLOCTEXT(\"{{namespace}}\", \"{{group}}\", \"{{text}}\")"
  The names in braces are filled in per string: {{text}} {{raw}} {{group}} {{namespace}} {{table}} {{field}} {{location}} {{index}}.
  A shape that is not one line per string is what `Template` is for.
export.text-group-two-namespaces:
Group `{Group}` is gathered into two namespaces.
  `{Table}.{Field}` says `{Says}`.
  `{FirstTable}.{FirstField}` says `{FirstSays}`. ({FirstAt})
  A group is one file and a namespace holds files, so the columns gathering into one have to agree. Split the group, or name the namespace on one column and let the rest take it.
export.text-pattern-unclosed-brace: The `text` target's `{Setting}` opens a `{{` at position {At} and never closes it: `{Pattern}`. Write `{{{{` for a literal brace.
export.text-pattern-name-is-per-file: The `text` target's `{Setting}` uses `{{{Name}}}`, which describes the file rather than one string, and this pattern is written once per string: `{Pattern}`.
export.text-pattern-name-is-per-string: The `text` target's `{Setting}` uses `{{{Name}}}`, which describes one gathered string. A header and a footer are written once for the whole file, so there is no string for it to name: `{Pattern}`.
export.text-template-missing: The `text` target's template `{Name}` is not there. The path is read relative to the working directory, which is `{Directory}`.
export.text-line-ending-unknown: The `text` target's `LineEnding` is `{LineEnding}`. It has to be `lf` or `crlf`.
export.constant-type-not-rendered: Constant `{Name}` has type `{Type}`, which the {Generator} generator cannot render.
export.target-no-optional-fields:
Target `{Target}` does not support optional fields yet.
  Table `{Table}` column `{Column}` is typed `{Type}?`, so a row may have no value for it.
  Remove the target from the recipe, or drop the `?` and let the column read a blank as the type's empty value.
export.target-no-composite-keys:
Target `{Target}` does not support keys of several columns yet.
  Table `{Table}` is keyed by `{Key}`, which a reader looks up by several values at once.
  The lookup that implies has a different shape in every language, so each target takes it on separately - remove the target from the recipe, or key the table by one column.
export.target-no-optional-elements:
Target `{Target}` does not support arrays whose elements may be absent yet.
  Table `{Table}` column `{Column}` is typed `{Type}?[]`, so an element may have no value.
  Remove the target from the recipe, or move the `?` outside the brackets and let every element hold a value.
export.target-no-nested-fields:
Target `{Target}` does not support nested fields yet.
  Table `{Table}` field `{Field}` is a record group of {Count} member(s).
  Remove the target from the recipe, or write the columns flat without `{Separator}`.
export.target-no-record-in-record:
Target `{Target}` does not support a record inside a record yet.
  Table `{Table}` field `{Field}` has member `{Member}`, which is a record of {Count} member(s) rather than a value.
  Remove the target from the recipe, or flatten that level - `{Field}{Separator}{Member}{Inner}` instead of `{Field}{Separator}{Member}{Separator}{Inner}`.
export.generated-file-name-clash: Two different files were generated for `{Path}`. A generated file is named after a table, an enum or a constant set, and two of those have names that reduce to the same file name. Rename one of them in the sheets.
export.log-mongodb-cleanup-failed: Could not clean up MongoDB shadow collections: {Detail}
export.log-mysql-cleanup-failed: Could not clean up MySQL shadow tables: {Detail}
export.log-redis-cleanup-failed: Could not clean up Redis shadow keys: {Detail}
export.log-unreal-enum-not-blueprint: Enum `{Enum}` label `{Label}` has value {Value}, which does not fit the uint8 a BlueprintType enum has to be. Generating it as a plain int32 UENUM instead: readable from C++, not visible in Blueprint, and neither are the fields typed with it.
